mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at, is_active FROM public.user WHERE username = #{username} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at, is_active FROM public.user WHERE email = #{email} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.user ( username, email, password, full_name, phone, address, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at, is_active ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{fullName}, #{phone}, #{address}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.user SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
